title: Rockstar Made 2 of the 5 Best-Selling Games Ever
caption:
The 5 best-selling games ever: Tetris 520M (all versions), Minecraft 425M+, GTA V nearly 235M, Red Dead Redemption 2 89M+, Wii Sports 82.9M. Rockstar owns two spots, and GTA 6 lands Nov 19.
How long until GTA 6 cracks this list?

Sources: Take-Two (Q2 FY27), Nintendo, Xbox, The Tetris Company
